'''Sakuubians''' were the native [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Sakuub]]. They were [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]] with [[Color/Legends|blue]] skin, yellow [[Cat/Legends|cat]]-like [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], distinctive facial ridges, three-fingered hands, and four horns on their forehead. [[Dular]] and [[Pharika]] were Sakuubians. Nevertheless, it was unsure whether Pharika was a true Sakuubian or was simply wearing a disguise.
